description: 尼姆佐印度防御 E32 — d5推进封锁d线，切断黑方纵线资源

intro.popup:
线路控制第8课
封闭对方的线路！
不只是占线——
有时候封住对手的线路更有力
intro.popup_en:
Line Control, Lesson 8
Close the opponent's lines!
Control is not only about occupying an open file; sometimes blocking the opponent's route is more powerful.

outro.popup:
封线总结
d5一推，d线被封死
封线=剥夺对手的线路资源
攻守兼备的线路控制！
outro.popup_en: Summary: d5 completely blocks the d-file. Closing a line denies the opponent access to its resources. Line control can serve both attack and defense.

moves.popup_en: d4 opens with a queenside pawn and occupies the center.
moves.popup:
d4后翼开局
占领中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and attacks e4.
moves.popup:
Nf6发展
攻击e4

moves.popup_en: c4 challenges d5 and fights for central space in the Queen's Gambit setup.
moves.popup:
c4后翼弃兵
争夺d5

moves.popup_en: ...e6 reinforces Black's position and prepares ...Bb4, the Nimzo-Indian idea.
moves.popup:
e6稳固
准备Bb4尼姆佐

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops and increases White's control of d5.
moves.popup:
Nc3发展
控制d5

moves.popup_en: ...Bb4! The Nimzo-Indian bishop pins the knight on c3, restricting White's control of the center.
moves.popup:
Bb4！尼姆佐印度
钉住c3马
黑方牵制白方中心控制

moves.popup_en: e3 reinforces d4 and supports White's center.
moves.popup:
e3稳固
支持d4

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king first.
moves.popup:
O-O王车易位
黑方先安全

moves.popup_en: Bd3 develops and prepares a central advance.
moves.popup:
Bd3发展
准备中心推进

moves.popup_en: ...d5 challenges the center and gains space. The d-file may soon open.
moves.popup:
d5反击中心
黑方争夺空间
注意：d线即将打开

moves.popup_en: Nf3 completes White's minor-piece development.
moves.popup:
Nf3发展
白方出子完成

moves.popup_en: ...c5 counterattacks d4. Black actively challenges White's center.
moves.popup:
c5反击d4
黑方积极对抗
白方中心受压

moves.popup_en: O-O secures White's king and prepares for central exchanges.
moves.popup:
O-O白方易位
准备应对中心兑换

moves.popup_en: ...dxc4 exchanges pawns and leaves the d-file semi-open. Black may use ...Rd8, so White needs a plan.
moves.popup:
dxc4兑换
d线半开放！
黑方Rd8将可以利用d线
白方必须做出反应

moves.popup_en: Bxc4 recaptures. The bishop occupies c4 and pressures d5.
moves.popup:
Bxc4重提
白象占c4，压制d5

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and reinforces central control.
moves.popup:
Nc6发展
增援中心

moves.popup_en: a3! White challenges the bishop on b4, removes the pin, and prepares bxc3 followed by cxd4.
moves.popup:
a3！驱逐b4象
白方消除牵制
为下一步bxc3后cxd4做准备

moves.popup_en: ...Bxc3 exchanges the bishop for the knight and changes the pawn structure.
moves.popup:
Bxc3兑换
黑方拆掉c3马
双兵换了马+象

moves.popup_en: bxc3 recaptures. White has a semi-open c-file but also doubled c-pawns.
moves.popup:
bxc3重提
c线半开放，但白方有双联兵

moves.popup_en: ...cxd4 exchanges on d4 and fully opens the d-file, giving Black a route for ...Rd8.
moves.popup:
cxd4！黑方兑换d4
d线完全开放
黑方Rd8将是强力棋

moves.popup_en: cxd4 recaptures and rebuilds a pawn on d4, but the d-file is now open and Black can contest it.
moves.popup:
cxd4白方重提
d4兵重建
但d线已开，黑方虎视眈眈

moves.popup_en: ...e5 advances and attacks d4, increasing pressure along the open d-file. How can White stop Black from taking control with ...Rd8?
moves.popup:
e5！黑方推进
攻击d4，开放d线
黑方将用Rd8控制d线
白方如何阻止？

moves.popup_en: d5! The pawn blocks the d-file completely and restricts e6. One move both closes the line and cramps Black's position, showing the strategic value of blocking an opponent's route.
moves.popup:
d5！封线绝招！
白兵推到d5，d线被完全封死
黑方e6格也被压制
一步兵，同时封线+压格
这就是封闭线路的战略价值！
